value.question: How do I track my order?
value.answer: Once your order is dispatched, you will receive a tracking number via email and SMS. Use it on our Track Order page or the courier website to follow your delivery in real time.

value.question: Can I return a product if I'm not satisfied?
value.answer: Yes. We offer a 30-day hassle-free return policy on most products. Items must be unused, sealed, and in original packaging. Contact us and we'll arrange the pickup at no cost to you.

value.question: Do you require a prescription for medicines?
value.answer: Prescription medicines are clearly marked on the product page. You will be prompted to upload a valid prescription at checkout for those products. Our pharmacists verify every prescription within 2 hours.

value.question: How long does delivery take?
value.answer: Standard delivery takes 2–4 business days. Express delivery (next-day) is available in major cities. Free shipping is available on orders above $50. Same-day delivery is available in select areas.

value.question: Are all products genuine and certified?
value.answer: Absolutely. Every product on DCare is sourced directly from certified manufacturers and authorized distributors. We carry the DRAP certification for all pharmaceutical products and conduct regular quality audits.

value.question: Can I speak with a pharmacist online?
value.answer: Yes! Our licensed pharmacists are available 9am–9pm Monday to Saturday via live chat and phone. Just click the chat button or call our helpline. Emergency consultations are available outside of business hours.
